what: C499 passages for the HELD corpus, tier 2. A container plus its passages, joined by container_id.
read_this_first: ABSENCE FROM THIS FILE IS NOT ABSENCE FROM THE ARCHIVE. This shard holds tier-2 containers ONLY. Before concluding a passage or a container does not exist, read site/arda_passages_shards.json, which names the shard for every container.
text_is_not_stored: Each passage carries start/end into its corpus file and no text (C1076-2). The corpus file is the text; gen_passages_c499.reconstructs() is the falsifier.
bases_are_also_inline:
Every passage carries its own content_tier_basis. This
 table is the vocabulary, not an indirection a reader must resolve.

bases.nv: does not verify against the t1 corpus above the measured floor; whether it is an editor's gloss, a scholar's argument, a fan's inference or the page's own prose is NOT mechanically decidable and is left open rather than guessed (C499's four open cases)
bases.floor: under the measured floor, so map/ardatext.py was NOT asked -- below it the matcher measures coincidence rather than attestation (floors imported from quoted_check.MINWORDS and probe_check.MIN_SAFE via map/gen_passages.py)
bases.cand: CANDIDATE FOR READING, NOT EVIDENCE. Under the word floor but clear of the character floor, which is the shape of a short DISTINCTIVE quotation rather than a coincidence. HIS RULING C1074-3: do not lower the bar, do surface what it refuses. Asserts nothing.
